joy.definition:
n. the emotion of great happiness
n. something or someone that provides a source of happiness
joy.translation:
n. 欢喜, 乐事, 高兴
vt. 使快乐, 令人高兴
vi. 欢喜

joy-riders.translation: (joy-rider 的复数) n. 驾车兜风的人

joy-rides.translation: (joy-ride 的复数) v. 驾车兜风

joy-riding.translation: (joy-ride 的现在分词) v. 驾车兜风

joyancy.translation: n. 高兴, 快乐, 欢庆

joybells.translation: n. 报喜钟, 庆祝钟

joyce.definition: n. influential Irish writer noted for his many innovations (such as stream of consciousness writing) (1882-1941)

joyce carol oates.translation: [网络] 欧茨；乔伊斯·卡罗尔·欧茨；奥兹

joycean.translation:
n. 乔伊斯(爱尔兰小说家, 诗人)专家, 拥护或喜欢乔伊斯的人
a. 乔伊斯的

joyed.translation:
n. 欢乐, 快乐；乐趣；高兴
vi. 欣喜, 欢喜
vt. 高兴, 使快乐

joyful.translation: a. 欢喜的, 高兴的, 令人高兴的

joylessly.definition: r in a joyless manner; without joy

joylessness.definition: n. a feeling of dismal cheerlessness

joyner.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 乔伊纳 Joiner的变体

joynson.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 乔因森取自父名，来源于John,含义是“约翰之子”(son of John)

joyous.definition: a. full of or characterized by joy
joyous.translation: a. 快乐的, 高兴的

joyously.definition: r in a joyous and gleeful manner

joyride.definition:
n. a ride in a car taken solely for pleasure
v. ride in a car with no particular goal and just for the pleasure of it
joyride.translation: n. 驾车兜风, 偷车乱开, 乘汽车兜风, 追求享受的行动, 胡作非为

joyrided.definition:
past tense of joyride
n. a ride in a car taken solely for pleasure
v. ride in a car with no particular goal and just for the pleasure of it
joyrided.translation: (joyride 的过去时) n. 驾车兜风, 偷车乱开, 乘汽车兜风, 追求享受的行动, 胡作非为

joyrider.translation:
n. 乘汽车兜风的人
[法] 偷开车者

joyriders.translation:
(joyrider 的复数) n. 乘汽车兜风的人
[法] 偷开车者

joyrides.definition:
n. a ride in a car taken solely for pleasure
v. ride in a car with no particular goal and just for the pleasure of it
joyrides.translation: n. 驾车游玩, 兜风( joyride的复数形式 )

joyriding.definition: v ride in a car with no particular goal and just for the pleasure of it

joys.definition:
n the emotion of great happiness
n something or someone that provides a source of happiness
v feel happiness or joy
v make glad or happy
joys.translation: n. 欢乐( joy的名词复数 ); 乐事; 成功; 满意

joystick.definition: n. a manual control consisting of a vertical handle that can move freely in two directions; used as an input device to computers or to devices controlled by computers
joystick.translation:
n. (飞机的)操纵杆
[计] 控制杆, 操纵杆

joysticks.definition:
n. a lever used by a pilot to control the ailerons and elevators of an airplane
n. a manual control consisting of a vertical handle that can move freely in two directions; used as an input device to computers or to devices controlled by computers
joysticks.translation: n. 操纵杆( joystick的复数形式 )
